issue_context.title: Potential data race accessing manager#apiStatusVersions
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:
```
        // Map from (mirror) pod UID to latest status version successfully sent to the API server.
        // apiStatusVersions must only be accessed from the sync thread.
        apiStatusVersions map[kubetypes.MirrorPodUID]uint64
```
apiStatusVersions is written from syncBatch(), syncPod() and read by needsUpdate().
For syncBatch(), there is no write lock taken, only podStatusesLock.RLock is taken (meant to protect podStatuses).
syncPod is called by syncBatch() and a goroutine in manager#Start()

**What you expected to happen**:
Writes to apiStatusVersions should be properly protected.

review_comments: Currently, it appears `syncPod` is holding the apiStatusVersionsLock` for the entire function - are updates to `apiStatusVersions` truly occurring the entire team, or could we restrict holding the lock to a "critical section" (similar to `syncBatch`).

The lock can be narrowed to line 552:
```
        m.apiStatusVersions[kubetypes.MirrorPodUID(pod.UID)] = status.version
```

Do you know which `lock` this comment is referring to? Does the existence of the mentioned lock have any relation to the lock you are proposing that we introduce? It could be great to update this comment to reflect the true state of the code base after your changes.
I think the comment referred to m.podStatusesLock.
